title: infer cave route from cruise
context: Katsuragi's retrospective explanation to Yahiko is overheard by hidden Class D pupils near an occupied cave.
observed_actions: Describes seeing a forest trail during the ship's deliberate prelanding circumnavigation; he had taken the most direct path from pier and found the cave.
observed_result: His group reaches the strategically placed cave early and occupies it, although Yahiko may have taken the activation decision.
epistemic_limits: Katsuragi's own speech grounds the deduction, not Kiyotaka's deduction. Specific occupation-card activation may be attributable to Yahiko; do not claim Katsuragi alone chose it.
information_available: Only knowledge accessible to this actor at the cited story time; later disclosures may not retroactively become memory.
counterfactual_test: Alter resources, health, opposition, incentives or information and allow failure; do not force observed outcome.
